paragraphs.en: A scholarship fund may claim to offer opportunity, but its real effects depend on who can apply and what support follows admission. Students can demand fair treatment without being expected to save enough money before asking for assistance. Students who lack money often carry a burden that cannot be solved by encouragement alone. They may spend evenings working, consume cheaper meals, and struggle to afford transport. A useful program must acknowledge these conditions rather than assume effort will always produce success. Its organizers should seek evidence about barriers, not merely celebrate the few applicants who win awards. Otherwise a generous public image may conceal a process that excludes precisely the people it says it intends to serve.
paragraphs.zh: 奖学金基金可以声称提供机会，但真正效果取决于谁能申请、录取后得到什么支持。学生可以要求公平待遇，不应被期待先存够钱才求助。缺钱学生常背负不能靠鼓励解决的负担。他们晚上工作、吃便宜饭菜、难以支付交通费。有用项目必须承认这些条件，而不能假设努力必然成功。组织者应寻找障碍的证据，不只是庆祝少数获奖者，否则慷慨的公众形象可能遮住一种恰好排除目标人群的流程。

paragraphs.en: The university decided to share application guidance and hire advisers who understood local schools. Applicants could request help without having to beg or prove personal suffering repeatedly. The fund would assign a contact to each student and spare them unnecessary paperwork. It would also lend laptops, secure accessible housing, and compensate participants for travel to interviews. These measures did not confer academic ability, but they helped students obtain a fair chance to demonstrate what they already knew. Access should not depend on whether a family happens to possess the confidence, free time, and professional connections needed to navigate a complicated system.
paragraphs.zh: 大学共享申请指导、聘请熟悉本地学校的顾问。申请者可以求助，无需乞讨般请求或反复证明个人苦难。基金为每名学生安排联系人，免去不必要文书；借出电脑、保证无障碍住房、补偿面试交通费。这些措施不会赋予学术能力，却使学生有公平机会展示已有知识。参与机会不该取决于家庭是否碰巧拥有应对复杂制度所需的自信、空闲和职业关系。

paragraphs.en: Financial planning required honest choices. Donors could endow a lasting fund or donate a smaller amount for immediate needs. The university had to deal with fluctuating income and avoid commitments that would drain reserves. Investments should offset rising costs, yet risky speculation might waste resources meant for students. Managers were expected to utilize professional advice, harness community expertise, and explain how benefits derive from spending decisions. They could not insist that every criticism showed ingratitude. People who contributed deserved clear accounts, and people receiving assistance deserved stability rather than promises dependent on the next fashionable fundraising campaign.
paragraphs.zh: 财务规划需要诚实选择。捐赠者可以捐建长期基金，也可以少量捐款解决眼前需求。大学必须应对收入波动，避免耗尽储备的承诺。投资应抵消成本上涨，但冒险投机可能浪费学生资源。管理者需要利用专业建议、调动社区知识、说明开支决定如何产生收益。他们不能坚持每种批评都是忘恩负义。出资者应得清晰账目，受助者应得稳定，而不是依赖下一轮热门筹款活动的承诺。

paragraphs.en: Campus life brought challenges beyond tuition. An exhausted student could hear a dog howl outside the dormitory and feel even more isolated. A cruel remark might sting for days, especially when peers seemed to enjoy advantages he could never inherit. Advisers tried to help without treating hardship as a personal defect. The aim was not to persecute families with difficult questions or rob students of privacy. It was to make participation possible. Someone should be able to zoom in on a lecture slide, acquire useful skills, and participate in discussion without first having to explain every hidden cost of being there.
paragraphs.zh: 校园生活的挑战不止学费。疲惫学生听到宿舍外狗嗥，可能更加孤独；刻薄话可能刺痛数日，尤其当同伴似乎享有他永远无法继承的优势。顾问提供帮助，却不把困境视为个人缺陷。目标不是用难堪问题迫害家庭，或剥夺学生隐私，而是让参与成为可能。学生应该能够放大讲义、学得技能、参加讨论，无需先解释身处这里的每一种隐藏代价。

paragraphs.en: Graduates did not all earn high salaries, yet many found ways to succeed on their own terms. Some would repay loans gradually; others helped younger students reap the benefits of experience. The fund could not conquer every inequality, and its administration had to resist arrangements that might corrupt its purpose. What it could do was make certain opportunities less dependent on inherited wealth. Its most persuasive achievement was not a photograph of a confident winner. It was the continuing ability of ordinary students to study, make mistakes, ask for help, and discover a future without exhausting all their energy on staying afloat.
paragraphs.zh: 毕业生并非都有高收入，但许多人按自己的标准取得成功。有的逐渐还清贷款，有的帮助学弟学妹从经验中获益。基金无法克服所有不平等，管理也必须抵制会腐蚀宗旨的安排。它能做的是让某些机会减少对继承财富的依赖。最有说服力的成果不是自信获奖者的照片，而是普通学生能够持续学习、犯错、求助、发现未来，不必把全部精力耗在勉强维持生活上。
